title: Orestes of Macedon
summary: Raleigh names Orestes of Macedon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Orestes, a sonne of Archelaus of Macedon. He is not Orestes of Mycenae, and not Orestes of Thessaly. The one-word title would fold onto those records, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter I, §. I, sig. 460b
